en:
So this is the rumored ruin! I heard
everyone's memories get played back
right in front of us! I can't wait―I hope
it starts soon!
H-Hey, Precis! Don't go off on\nyour own. We have no idea\nwhat's in there!

You're such a scaredy-cat! I'll
be totally fine. Anyway, Captain
Papa Claude! I'm gonna go
check that way!
P-Papa Claude... Now that she's\nsaid it out loud, it's kind of...
Ah! Now is not the time to be\nthinking about that! Wait up,\nPrecis!

It is quite a rare experience to see the
great Admiral Kenny, whose name is
etched in Federation history, being
pushed around by a young girl like that.
Yes, it would be dangerous for\nthe two of them alone. We\nshould follow―
Hm!
Please, give me your opinion on\nsomething.
Oh, sure.

Mr. Fidel... and myself... And
this is Central Leslia, the
capital of the Kingdom of
Leslia on Faykreed IV.
Whoa, so these are Anne's\nmemories!
You've returned.
There was a sudden flash of\nlight! I thought, "This is it!" and\nrushed back.

Still, this is incredible. It's
different from a hologram. It
feels like the real Fidel is right
here in front of me.
Would you be happy if\nsomeone gave you a stuffed\nanimal?
Huh? Uh...
You had such a serious look on\nyour face, and then you\nsuddenly ask that, Anne?

For me, this is an important
question that I still haven't
found the answer to! Captain,
what do you think?
Men might not like them.
It depends on the item.
I'd sleep with it every night.
Hmm, I don't think men would\nbe very happy with that.

I thought so... I used to give my
colleagues handmade stuffed
animals for their birthdays
every time...
Handmade every time? That's\nquite the effort...
But the reactions were... mixed.\nI'll think of something else for\nnext time.
So the Captain agrees with\nyou, Fidel. I guess men really\ndon't like stuffed animals...
Well, I've received a stuffed\nanimal from Anne before, but...\nhow should I put this...
Mmph, mmph-mmph!!
Hey, what are you doing,\nCaptain, Papa Claude!!
(Don't say another word,\nPrecis!)

(Eeeek!! Don't look at me with
such a scary face, Captain!
Fine, I get it, I won't say
anything else!)
Hm? Did something happen?
Well, I think it depends on the\nitem. Some people might want\none if it's their favorite animal.
A favorite animal? Like a cat?
The basic theory that research\nis vital for marketing. That was\nvery helpful.
So the Captain agrees with\nyou, Fidel. Even for a single\ngift, research is essential.

As I thought, we must clearly
define our target audience and
build products and services
that meet their needs.
Differentiating from similar\nproducts is also a key element\nof branding. In that case...

I must get home immediately to
observe cats so I can recreate their
loveliness in a plushie! No, actually, I
just want to pet them... Cats, cats...
Uh... is Anne trying to start\nsome kind of cat-specialized\nplushie company?
Of course. I'm so happy with\nmine that I sleep with it every\nnight.
Every night...
Yes.
Is that something everyone\ndoes?
Probably? I assume everyone\ndoes.
...The Captain, the First Officer,\nVictor... could it be that even\nCommander Dean...
So the Captain is the same\ntype of person as Fidel...
No way!? The Captain and\nFidel sleep with stuffed animals\nevery night!?
It's better if the subordinates\ndon't know. It affects the\nCaptain's dignity.
Does that mean he also sleeps\nwith the stuffed animal I gave\nhim?
...You're panicking... I take it\nyou didn't like that stuffed\nanimal...
Ho, so it's an "Evelysse stuffed\nanimal"! Quite a masterpiece. I'd\nlove to see it sometime...
No. It's a "banana stuffed\nanimal."
(What kind of banana stuffed\nanimal looks like Evelysse!?)

(Ah... could it be that one?
Maybe the yellow of the
banana looks like Evelysse's
golden hair...!?)
Precis, what do you think?
Hmm, if you're that worried,\nwhy not just ask her directly\nwhat she wants?
...Actually, I've already tried\nthat...

(Sigh... it's been 10 days since I started
this investigation to find out what Relia
wants. Maybe I really should just ask
her...)

(No, that won't do. The surprise
is part of the gift. I have to
find out what Relia wants
without her knowing!)
So this is the memory from\nthat time.
I can't believe those memories\nare being played back so\nconveniently...
And then, ten days into my\ninvestigation, my chance finally\narrived.
Relia, do you have a moment?
What is it, Fiore?
Tell me, what's the one thing\nyou want most right now?
Hmm, let me see...
(Thank you, Fiore! I've been\nwaiting for someone to ask\nthat question!)
Land.
L-land!?
I never imagined Relia would\nwant something like that...
Well, I'd expect as much. I\nnever imagined Relia would be\nthe type to ask for land...
Captain! How on earth am I\nsupposed to represent "land"\nwith a stuffed animal!?
Ah... so it's already been\ndecided that the present has\nto be a plushie.

It's still a work in progress! Just a
patch of dirt would be too lonely, so I
should add some plants, right!? What
do you think, Captain!?

(...Hey, Papa Claude. No matter
how you look at it, Emmerson
is the one who told Relia to
ask for land, right?)
(Most likely. My apologies for\nthe trouble my descendant is\ncausing...)
I agree with Anne; I think\nchoosing the right gift can be\nincredibly difficult.

Even if you ask the person directly
what they want, they might hold back,
making it impossible to find out what
they truly desire.

And of course, there's the
desire to surprise them by
buying something without them
noticing.
Does that mean you've\nstruggled with picking out a\ngift yourself, Ronyx?
Who was it for~? ...Actually, I\ndon't even need to ask.
N-no, I didn't mean just for her,\nI was speaking in general\nterms...
Ah, look, look! This looks like\none of Papa Claude's\nmemories!
I can hear the sound of waves.\nMaybe it's some kind of port\ntown?
(Hmm, are those earrings?)
(I don't recall her wearing\nearrings like those when we\ndeparted from planet Stream.)
Oh, these?
A wonderful man gave them to\nme as a gift while I was\nseparated from the captain.
I... I see...
Jeez, I told you it doesn't mean\nanything!
Right, of course it doesn't...
Um, Mr. Ronyx?
Oh, Lati. What is it?
Actually, about Ilia's earrings...
Um, Mr. Ronyx? Are you\nlistening?
Ah, sorry. I was spacing out for\na moment.
I have somewhere I need to go.\nI'll see you later, Lati.
Welcome!
(So she's become close enough\nwith some man to receive a\ngift while we were separated...)

(I believe they were a pale
color. Hmph, he has no taste.
Something more vibrant would
suit her much better...)
Does this one catch your eye?\nYou have excellent taste, sir.\nThis piece just arrived today...

(That vivid red is beautiful. It would look
wonderful against her golden hair. But
the detailing on this one is also
exquisite...)

Are you interested in that one
as well? You seem to be giving
this a lot of thought. Is it a gift
for someone special?
No, well...

Oh, how bashful! I'll do my
absolute best to help you find
the perfect piece for your
loved one.

(I suppose entering a shop like
this alone always leads people
to assume you're buying a gift
for a lover...)

(Wait... if she received it while
we were separated, does that
mean it was from that man,
Roak, from the past?)

(Ilia, you're supposed to return to your
own time once the mission is over.
Regardless of the circumstances, isn't
that simply improper!?)
Sir...?
...No, my apologies. I'll have to\ncome back another time.
(I suppose the most improper\none of all is me, for being so\nindecisive...)
Huh? You ended up not buying\nanything. Didn't you find\nanything you liked?
Ah, no, well...

I'm telling you, those red
earrings from before would
have looked great on Claude's
Mom!

But it's true that once you're actually
looking at the items, it's hard to decide.
You start wondering if they'll actually
like the gift.

Y-yes, exactly... I've reached a point
where I'm no longer sure what kind of
jewelry or what colors of gemstones
she prefers.
If you keep thinking like that,\nyou'll never actually give her a\npresent!
In the end, did you give Ilia\nthose earrings, Ronyx?

Yes, I did. They were a
beautiful piece with delicate
detailing. I believe that was the
first gift I ever gave her.

Ooh, look at you! I wonder if
she still has them? I'll have to
ask Claude's Mom about it
later.

Unfortunately, even back then, I
couldn't choose something myself; I
simply bought the piece she had been
eyeing at the jewelry store.
Choosing a gift really is a\ndifficult task.
Still, that's totally fine! Claude's\nMom was happy, right?
Well, I believe she was.
He noticed that I liked those\nearrings. That alone shows how\nmuch he cares about me.
I believe Ilia was happy\nbecause of that.
Thank you. I hope that is how\nshe feels.
Everyone seems so conflicted.\nI'd just trust my gut and buy\nsomething!
Trust your gut...?

Yeah. Like, close your eyes, think of the
person you're giving it to, open them,
and buy the first thing that gives you a
spark!
A spark... That sounds difficult.
The important thing is just\nthinking about the person\nyou're giving it to.
Oh, Claude!
What's up? Did you come to\nbuy jam too, Claude?
You too, Precis?

Oh, this is one of my memories. Wow,
it's exactly how it was back then! This
was when I was looking for a souvenir
for my dad in Salva.
Well, jam does have a long\nshelf life.
Exactly!
Pop quiz! Which jam did I pick\nas a souvenir for my dad?
Chili Pepper Jam!
Banana Jam!
Mackerel Miso Jam!
Ding-ding-ding!
Chili Pepper Jam!? Does\nsomething like that even exist?
That is intriguing. I would love\nto try some!
...Huh?

I asked Miki to make some for
me once. But she turned me
down, saying it didn't sound
tasty.
And yet, it's bright red and\nlooks just as delicious as\nstrawberry jam...

R-right, so Precis must have
bought it while thinking of the
recipient. Does your father like
spicy food?
Buzz! Wrong!

Banana jam is way too normal.
You're no fun, Captain! It's
gotta be a flavor so wild it
makes your eyes pop out!
C-Captain! I think it's a great\nchoice. Banana jam! Please\ndon't be so discouraged...!
The correct answer is... chili\npepper jam!
What? What did you say!?
I said chili pepper jam!
Is that... actually edible?
Haha! Papa Claude's reaction is\njust like Claude's! They really\nare father and son.
...Now, how should I put this,\nbut wouldn't anyone feel that\nway?
I wonder.

A-Anyway, I'm sure you bought
it with the recipient in mind,
Precis. Does your father like
spicy food?
What!? What's that!! There's a\njam that sounds that\ninteresting on Earth?
I have never heard of such a\nthing...
Neither have I...
I'm definitely going to find some\nand get it as a souvenir for my\nold man!
Oh, the answer is... chili pepper\njam!
What? What did you say?!
I said... chili pepper jam!
Is that... actually edible?
Haha! Papa Claude's reaction is\njust like Claude's! They really\nare father and son.
...Now, how should I put this...\nwouldn't anyone feel that way?
I wonder?

At any rate, I'm sure you
bought it with the recipient in
mind, Precis. Does your father
like spicy food?
Hmm, I wonder. If anything, I\nthink he's not very fond of it.
Then why on earth would you\nbuy such a thing?!
Because it's funny!
I mean, it's sold in a store, so\nI'm sure it's edible.

He might accidentally eat it,
freak out, and get a little mad,
but in the end, it'll just be a
funny story.

I bought all sorts of other
souvenirs too. Like a dull
soldering iron and some dried
slime.

Now, every time I bring a gift, it's a
tradition for my old man to have a good
laugh and ask, "What on earth is this?
Why would anyone think to sell this?"
If it brings a smile to both the\ngiver and the receiver, then it\nis a wonderful gift.
I suppose this is also a way of\ncarefully choosing a gift with\nthe recipient in mind.
Hm? Is there something else...?
I already told you! That's how\nyou connect the wiring over\nthere.
What?! If you do it that way,\ntoo much current will flow and\nthe solder will melt!
Hm? Is this Precis's family\nhome?
Yeah, it looks like it. Oh, Claude\nis visiting.
He's suggesting we have some\ntea... wait, could this memory\nbe...?
I thought I'd try something\nfancy for today's tea―jam tea!

J-jam tea!? Ugh, that is so not
you. You shouldn't force it;
you're better off just sticking
to gyokuro.
Jam tea... I have a bad feeling\nabout this...
It's... it's spicy! What is this?!\nIt's incredibly spicy!!
Hey, Dad! What on earth did\nyou give Claude to drink?
What do you mean? It's just\ntea. I just put plenty of jam in\nit...
Oh no! Don't tell me that jam\nwas the stuff I bought in\nSalva?
Yes, it was...
Salva's famous chili pepper\njam?!
Yikes.
I don't care what it is...\nw-water...

I remember getting into a huge fight
with my dad back then. That's what
happens when you try to serve
something you're not used to just to
impress Claude!
Oh, Claude... I wonder if he was\nalright...

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
